{{- /* Artalk — full upstream-equivalent loader */ -}} {{- $a := .Site.Params.artalk | default dict -}} {{- if not ($a.server | default "") }}{{/* credentials required */}}{{ else }} {{- $c := .Site.Params.comments | default dict -}} {{- $lazyload := $c.lazyload | default false -}} {{- $count := $c.count | default false -}} {{- $option := $a.option | default dict -}} {{- $use := $c.use | default slice -}} {{- if reflect.IsSlice $use | not }}{{ if $use }}{{ $use = slice $use }}{{ else }}{{ $use = slice }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $norm := slice -}} {{- range $use }}{{ $norm = $norm | append (. | title) }}{{ end -}} {{- $first := "" }}{{ if gt (len $norm) 0 }}{{ $first = index $norm 0 }}{{ end -}} {{- $js := $a.js | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/artalk@2.9.1/dist/Artalk.js" -}} {{- $css := $a.css | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/artalk@2.9.1/dist/Artalk.css" -}} {{- $siteName := $a.site | default .Site.Title -}} {{- end }}
